guide.api.rest: lists every JSON route. Start at /api/v1/studio.
guide.details.title: The details
guide.image.brush.name: The brush
guide.image.brush.text: Three widths, and a loupe follows the brush while you draw. The area you mark is the area that changes, so keep the mark close to what should change.
guide.image.generateOrEdit.name: Generate, or Edit
guide.image.generateOrEdit.text: Generate writes a picture from a prompt. Edit changes one you already have, and needs an image from the strip: click a frame, then Edit this.
guide.image.look.name: A Look
guide.image.look.text: A chip adds one sentence after your words. Each model offers only the options its own test kept.
guide.image.markRegion.name: Mark a region
guide.image.markRegion.text: Fill the area you want changed. Do not circle it: the mark's own shape is the shape that comes back repainted.
guide.image.rewrite.name: Rewrite
guide.image.rewrite.text: It writes out the words you typed, and the words in the marked areas, at length. Each answer lands where it was written, and the Look is added after them. In a batch your words lead every image and each row adds to them, and the press writes a row from its own picture.
guide.image.runCancel.name: Run and Cancel
guide.image.runCancel.text: Run empties the form it sent. Cancel puts all of it back, the marked region included.
guide.image.strip.name: The strip
guide.image.strip.text: Images stay in the strip. Download the ones you want before you clear it.
guide.image.wait.name: The wait
guide.image.wait.text: An edit reads your prompt and images for about a minute before its first step. The line in the top bar counts that time.
guide.image.whatChanges.name: What changes there
guide.image.whatChanges.text: One row per marked colour says what changes in that area. Or pick the Mark a region template and leave the rows empty.
guide.music.editScore.name: Edit score
guide.music.editScore.text: Opens the score beside a live sheet. Generate then makes a new take from the score you edited.
guide.music.planning.name: Planning
guide.music.planning.text: Melody and chords writes a score first. Direct generation skips it and returns no useful score.
guide.music.recording.name: A recording
guide.music.recording.text: A recording makes a cover with Generate, or a transcription with Compose.
guide.music.songsStrip.name: The songs strip
guide.music.songsStrip.text: Download all saves every song as a file. Clear all removes them from this browser.
guide.music.style.name: A style
guide.music.style.text: One sentence with the language, genre, mood, instruments, vocal and tempo. A genre word alone is thin.
guide.music.wait.name: The wait
guide.music.wait.text: A song takes longer than a picture. The run button counts the time, and Cancel keeps the finished songs.
guide.music.words.name: The words
guide.music.words.text: Section tags name each part. Leave the words blank, with instrumental on, for a tune with no singing.
guide.sheet.title: How to use this studio
guide.start.title: Start here
guide.steps.image.look.name: Add a Look if you want one
guide.steps.image.look.text: A chip adds one sentence after your words. It costs nothing to leave empty.
guide.steps.image.runBar.name: Run, then read the bar
guide.steps.image.runBar.text: The bar under the picture says the model, the seed and the time. Run empties the form it sent; Cancel puts it back.
guide.steps.image.say.name: Say what you want
guide.steps.image.say.text: A subject, a setting and a light. Press Generate and read the picture before you change anything.
guide.steps.music.listen.name: Listen, then change one thing
guide.steps.music.listen.text: Edit the score, reuse the style, or cover a recording. One change per take makes the comparison honest.
guide.steps.music.oneTake.name: Generate one take
guide.steps.music.oneTake.text: The first take tests the style. A second seed tells you whether the style or the luck was good.
guide.steps.music.styleWords.name: Write a style and the words
guide.steps.music.styleWords.text: The style sentence carries the genre, the instruments and the tempo. The words carry the song.
guide.steps.video.addClip.name: Add a clip only to edit one
guide.steps.video.addClip.text: Generate starts from words. Edit changes a clip you already have and needs an effect.
guide.steps.video.addStill.name: Add a still or a track if you want one
guide.steps.video.addStill.text: An image sets the first frame. A track sets the audio.
guide.steps.video.describe.name: Describe the shot
guide.steps.video.describe.text: The subject, the action, the camera and the light. A template fills the shape of a shot.
guide.steps.video.generateScrub.name: Generate, then scrub
guide.steps.video.generateScrub.text: The whole render must finish before the clip plays. Cancel stops it and keeps what finished.
guide.steps.voice.play.name: Generate, then play
guide.steps.voice.play.text: The preview and the strip keep every take. Download all saves them in one press.
guide.steps.voice.script.name: Write the script
guide.steps.voice.script.text: The words to speak, with cues such as [whispers] inline if the model takes them.
guide.steps.voice.voice.name: Choose a voice, or add a recording
guide.steps.voice.voice.text: Design describes a voice. Clone copies one from a clean recording of a single speaker.
guide.video.durationSize.name: Duration and size
guide.video.durationSize.text: Choose the output shape, resolution and duration before generating. Larger or longer clips take more time and memory.
guide.video.fastMode.name: Fast mode
guide.video.fastMode.text: LTX-2.5 offers Fast mode in Advanced. It uses float16 computation with the same weights for faster rendering; generated details may differ.
guide.video.gallery.name: The gallery
guide.video.gallery.noEdit.text: Select one clip to preview. Use its action buttons to download, copy inputs or remove it.
guide.video.gallery.text: Select one clip to preview. Its action buttons let you download, copy inputs, edit or remove it.
guide.video.generate.name: Generate
guide.video.generate.text: Generate a video from a prompt, optional image keyframes, or an audio track.
guide.video.generateOrEdit.name: Generate, or Edit
guide.video.generateOrEdit.text: Generate a video from a prompt, optional image keyframes, or an audio track. Edit requires explicitly choosing a clip and an adapter; viewing a gallery clip does not select it for editing.
guide.video.promptTemplates.name: Prompt and templates
guide.video.promptTemplates.text: Describe the subject, action, setting and camera movement. Templates provide starting points; a Look adds to your words.
guide.video.references.name: References
guide.video.references.text: Add a still as a keyframe or an audio track to guide the video. Remove a reference with its cross; this does not delete a gallery result.
guide.video.rewriteEnhancement.name: Rewrite and enhancement
guide.video.rewriteEnhancement.text: Rewrite is an explicit prompt-writing action. Generate also runs the model’s prompt enhancer automatically before rendering.
guide.video.runCancel.name: Run and Cancel
guide.video.runCancel.text: Progress covers the whole render and reaches completion only when the clip is ready. Cancel stops the active operation.
guide.voice.clipActions.download.text: Download the selected audio from the action bar. The more menu includes Send to Video, Send to Clone and copying inputs.
guide.voice.clipActions.edit.text: Download or edit the selected audio from the action bar. The more menu includes Send to Video, Send to Clone and copying inputs.
guide.voice.clipActions.name: Clip actions
guide.voice.clone.design.text: Add a clean reference recording of one speaker. AuK does not require a transcript for cloning. Remove the reference before recording another one.
guide.voice.clone.drama.text: Add a clean reference recording and its exact transcript. Recordings longer than 15 seconds use the first 15 seconds; make the transcript match that excerpt.
guide.voice.clone.name: Clone a voice
guide.voice.duration.name: Duration
guide.voice.duration.text: Use automatic duration or set a target length in Advanced. A window that is too short can cut off words.
guide.voice.generate.name: Generate a clip
guide.voice.generate.text: Write the words you want spoken. Generate produces one continuous audio clip for the script.
guide.voice.preview.name: Preview and selection
guide.voice.preview.text: Click the waveform to choose a playback position. Drag the end handles to select a range, then play that selection. Playback speed changes the preview only.
guide.voice.runCancel.name: Run and Cancel
guide.voice.runCancel.text: The preview and gallery show generation progress. Cancel keeps completed clips; successful generation clears the submitted inputs.
guide.voice.sharedStatus.name: Shared status
guide.voice.sharedStatus.text: UI and API runs share one model slot. Other tabs follow the current operation and lock controls while it runs.
guide.voice.templates.design.text: For Design, choose a voice template or describe the voice. The script contains the words to speak; the voice description directs the delivery.
guide.voice.templates.drama.text: Pick a delivery template or put cues such as [whispers] inside the script. Drama-3 does not use a separate voice description.
guide.voice.templates.name: Templates and direction
guide.voice.tokenLimit.name: Audio token limit
guide.voice.tokenLimit.text: Advanced sets a safety limit per internal script chunk. Higher values allow longer output but may prolong repetition; the default is 2048.
